guide.name: 阿尺
guide.look: 一把会走路的黄色折尺，身体是一节一节的，最上面一节有两只圆眼睛，穿一双小红靴子，身后别着一支铅笔
guide.image_anchor: a walking yellow folding ruler with zigzag body segments, two round eyes on the top segment, small red boots and a pencil tucked behind it

chapters.name: 第一章 · 天上有人在敲鼓

pages.narration: 轰隆隆！窗外打雷了。阿尺把自己折成一架望远镜：「别怕，我们去云里看看是谁在敲鼓。」

visual.description: 雨天的窗边，窗外是一大团灰色的云，阿尺把身体折成望远镜的样子，趴在窗台上往云里看
visual.image_prompt: A cozy window on a rainy day with a big grey cloud outside, a walking yellow folding ruler with zigzag body segments, two round eyes on the top segment, small red boots and a pencil tucked behind it folds itself into a telescope shape on the windowsill to look at the cloud, warm indoor light, simple geometric shapes

pages.narration: 雷雨云像一座很高很高的塔。塔里的小冰粒被风吹上去、又掉下来，互相撞来撞去。

visual.description: 雷雨云画成一座很高的塔的剖面，塔里有向上和向下的箭头表示风，很多小冰粒在里面碰撞，阿尺站在塔底仰头看
visual.image_prompt: Cutaway of a tall thundercloud drawn as a tower, arrows showing wind carrying tiny ice grains up and down, grains bumping into each other inside, a walking yellow folding ruler with zigzag body segments, two round eyes on the top segment, small red boots and a pencil tucked behind it stands at the base looking up, architectural section style, soft blues and greys

follow_up.question: 云那么软，冰粒是从哪里来的？
follow_up.why: 通向高空温度低、水汽结冰

chapters.name: 第二章 · 云里攒了好多电

pages.narration: 冰粒撞得多了，就带上了电。塔顶攒了一种电，塔底攒了另一种电，越攒越多。

visual.description: 云塔的顶部聚着很多带加号的小粒子，底部聚着很多带减号的小粒子，阿尺用自己的身体当尺子量塔顶到塔底的距离
visual.image_prompt: A thundercloud tower with many small particles marked plus gathered at the top and particles marked minus gathered at the bottom, a walking yellow folding ruler with zigzag body segments, two round eyes on the top segment, small red boots and a pencil tucked behind it stretches out to measure the tower, clean diagram style, gentle colors

pages.narration: 电攒得太多，就会一下子冲出去，变成一道闪电，像在天上搭了一座发光的桥。

visual.description: 一道亮黄色的闪电从云塔底部一直连到远处的另一朵云，像一座发光的桥，阿尺在远处的小山坡上用铅笔把这座桥画下来
visual.image_prompt: A bright yellow lightning bolt connecting the bottom of a cloud tower to another cloud like a glowing bridge in the sky, a walking yellow folding ruler with zigzag body segments, two round eyes on the top segment, small red boots and a pencil tucked behind it sketches the bridge with its pencil from a faraway hill, dramatic but friendly lighting, geometric style

pages.narration: 闪电特别特别烫，旁边的空气一下子被烫得猛地鼓起来，「嘭」地推开。这个声音，就是雷。

visual.description: 闪电旁边的空气画成一圈一圈向外推开的波纹，波纹上写着「嘭」，阿尺用两只手捂着耳朵但在笑
visual.image_prompt: Rings of air pushing outward from a lightning bolt drawn as expanding circles, a big sound word in the middle, a walking yellow folding ruler with zigzag body segments, two round eyes on the top segment, small red boots and a pencil tucked behind it covers its ears while smiling, playful flat colors, simple shapes

follow_up.question: 为什么总是先看到闪电，后听到雷？

chapters.name: 第三章 · 数一数，雷有多远

pages.narration: 光跑得比声音快得多。看到闪电以后开始数数，每数到3，雷就离我们大约1公里。

visual.description: 画面左边一道闪电，右边一串声音波纹慢慢追过来，中间阿尺举着手指在数「1、2、3」，地上画着一段刻度尺标着「1公里」
visual.image_prompt: A lightning flash on the left and sound waves slowly travelling toward the right, a walking yellow folding ruler with zigzag body segments, two round eyes on the top segment, small red boots and a pencil tucked behind it counts on its fingers in the middle, a measuring scale on the ground marked in steps, clear diagram style, warm colors

pages.narration: 打雷的时候，待在屋里就很安全。阿尺说：「雷是空气在打鼓，我们在家里听就好。」

visual.description: 温暖的房间里，窗外还在下雨，阿尺坐在小凳子上，手里拿着纸和铅笔，在纸上记下这次数到了几
visual.image_prompt: A warm room with rain outside the window, a walking yellow folding ruler with zigzag body segments, two round eyes on the top segment, small red boots and a pencil tucked behind it sits on a little stool writing numbers on a sheet of paper, calm cozy lighting, clean flat geometric style

follow_up.question: 闪电打到地上会怎么样？
follow_up.why: 通向避雷针和户外防雷常识

child_page.prompt: 你还想知道什么？说给爸爸妈妈听，他们会帮你写在这里。

hard_notes: 雷雨云里冰晶和霰粒在上升气流中碰撞，造成电荷分离，云顶和云底积累相反的电荷，电压大到一定程度就放电，形成闪电。
闪电通道的温度最高可达约 2.8 万摄氏度（NWS：5 万华氏度，约为太阳表面的 5 倍），空气被瞬间加热、急剧膨胀又迅速收缩，产生的声波就是雷声。
光速远大于声速（声音在空气里约每秒 340 米），所以先见闪电、后闻雷声；秒数除以 3 约等于公里数。

sources.title: Understanding Lightning: Thunder（美国国家气象局 NWS）
Understanding Lightning（美国国家气象局 NWS）

uncertain: 云里为什么会起电，主流解释是冰晶和霰粒碰撞起电，但细节学界仍在研究；书里简化成「撞多了就带电」。
「数到 3 约 1 公里」是近似，声速随温度变化，只适合估算。

sensitive.how_handled: 很多孩子怕打雷。书里讲清楚雷是怎么来的，最后落到「在屋里很安全」，没有描写雷击伤人。给家长的户外常识：听得到雷声，就说明在雷击范围内，应尽快进屋；不在大树下躲雨、远离水边。这些按孩子的情况由家长来讲。

parent_card.weekend_project: 下次打雷时和孩子一起数秒：看到闪电开始数，听到雷停下，把数字除以 3，记在纸上，看雷是越来越近还是越来越远。
